title: Real classroom language arts: nonfiction context, theme, and rhetorical strategy analysis
learning_objective: Students review guided annotations for a nonfiction/AP-style text, infer context and audience, identify important words and themes, connect textual evidence to rhetorical strategies, and prepare independent analysis of overall purpose.
common_misconceptions: Treating context as only setting rather than situation, occasion, audience pressure, and purpose.
Listing important words without moving from subject to theme or purpose.
Identifying a rhetorical strategy without explaining how it supports a theme.
Assuming a text has only one theme instead of interacting surface and underlying themes.
